messages.telegram_welcome: 👋 Photos and videos posted here now appear on {target} (connected by {owner}).
messages.telegram_welcome_private: 👋 Photos and videos you send me now appear on {target} (connected by {owner}).
messages.telegram_welcome_quality: For the best quality send them as a file (📎 → File), or use the kinframe app: full quality, videos of any length, and you'll see when they've been seen.
messages.telegram_welcome_admin: Make me an admin of this group so I can see the photos (Group info → Administrators → Add).
messages.telegram_welcome_note: Deleting a photo here doesn't remove it from the frame; remove it in the kinframe app.
messages.telegram_ready: Ready ✓ I can see the photos in this group now.
messages.telegram_help:
I bring the photos and videos of this chat to a kinframe photo frame.
For full quality, send photos as a file (📎 → File), or use the kinframe app.
Files up to {limit} work here; send bigger videos with the app.
Deleting a photo here doesn't remove it from the frame; remove it in the kinframe app.
messages.telegram_help_unbound: Hi! I bring photos from Telegram to kinframe photo frames. To start, open a frame in the kinframe app and tap “Connect a Telegram group” or “Send from my Telegram”.
messages.telegram_not_connected: This chat isn't connected to a frame. In the kinframe app, open a frame and tap “Send from my Telegram”.
messages.telegram_stray: To connect this group to a frame, use “Connect a Telegram group” in the kinframe app.
messages.telegram_status: This group sends to {target} (connected by {owner}). Last photo: {last}.
messages.telegram_status_private: This chat sends to {target} (connected by {owner}). Last photo: {last}.
messages.telegram_status_paused: Sending is paused in the kinframe app.
messages.telegram_status_privacy_mode: The bot can't see photos: make it an admin of the group.
messages.telegram_status_bot_changed: This server uses a different Telegram bot now: connect the group again in the app.
messages.telegram_status_linked: Your Telegram is linked to {name} on kinframe.
messages.telegram_stop_denied: Only the managers of {target} can disconnect, in the app or here once they've linked Telegram.
messages.telegram_goodbye: This group no longer sends to {target}. Photos already there stay.
messages.telegram_goodbye_private: This chat no longer sends to {target}. Photos already there stay.
messages.telegram_unlinked: Your Telegram is no longer linked to kinframe.
messages.telegram_not_linked: This Telegram account isn't linked to kinframe.
messages.telegram_code_expired: This link has expired. Create a new one in the kinframe app.
messages.telegram_already_connected: This group already sends to {target}. Disconnect it first.
messages.telegram_wrong_kind_group: Open this link on the device where you use Telegram and pick a group.
messages.telegram_wrong_kind_private: Open this link in a private chat with the bot.
messages.telegram_already_linked: This Telegram account is already linked to another kinframe account. Unlink it there first.
messages.telegram_missing_permission: The person who made this link can no longer connect chats to {target}. Ask them for a new link.
messages.telegram_too_large_for_bot: This file is over {limit}, too big for the Telegram bot. Send it with the kinframe app instead.
messages.telegram_too_large: This file is too big for the frame (over {limit}).
messages.telegram_too_long: This video is longer than {minutes} minutes, so it can't go to the frame. Trim it, or send it with the kinframe app.
messages.telegram_spoiler: Photos marked as spoiler aren't sent to the frame.
messages.telegram_rate_limited: That's a lot of photos at once! The rest didn't go to the frame; try again in an hour or use the app.
messages.telegram_needs_attention: This group can't send to {target} right now. {owner} has been told.
messages.telegram_promo: Thanks {name}! Your photos are on {target}. In the kinframe app you'd see when they've been seen, get reactions and send videos in full quality.
messages.telegram_promo_linked_only: Only people on {target} can send here.
messages.telegram_join_ask: Then tap here to ask to join {target}:
